name: Nile

evidence.sql: C02: managed tenant-aware PostgreSQL is the primary type; D01: built on PostgreSQL 15
evidence.vector: V01: pgvector 0.8.0 pre-enabled, with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes

line: Managed PostgreSQL with tenant-aware data, authentication, and vector search.

free.text: Free: 1GB, 50M query tokens/mo; never pauses; no idle deletion rule

cells.metered: $15/mo Pro; Free overages for tokens and storage
cells.regions: AWS US West/EU Central; Azure East US
cells.selfhost: No, production database self-hosting is not established

sql.math: Free is $0 if storage stays at 1 GB and the token count stays at or under 50M tokens. Reads and writes do not decide the token count. 5 GB of egress is not priced.
With zero query tokens and 1 GB stored, the published Free base, compute and storage charges total $0. Backup costs remain unknown.

files.math: Nile does not provide an object storage service for customers.

jobs.math: Nile does not provide a managed job runner or queue
